work.error.bad_branch: The branch name is not valid.
work.error.bad_part: A part of the copy is not valid: retry.
work.error.bad_path: One of the chosen files is outside the project or is a link: remove it from the list.
work.error.bad_transfer: The copy file is not valid: cancel and start again.
work.error.git: git failed while preparing or receiving the copy.
work.error.incomplete: The copy arrived incomplete: retry to send the missing parts.
work.error.missing_base: This machine lacks the base commits of what is being carried: the whole branch has to be sent.
work.error.no_commits: The repository has no commits yet: make one and try again.
work.error.not_git: The folder is not a git repository: its work cannot be carried.
work.error.project_missing: This machine does not have the project: it is cloned before receiving the work.
work.error.sha_mismatch: The copy arrived damaged: cancel and start again.
work.error.storage: The copy could not be saved on the machine's disk: check the free space.
work.error.task_missing: The task is no longer on that machine: there is no work to bring.
work.error.too_large: It is over 1 GB: too much to copy. Push the branch and the other machine clones it.
work.error.transfer_missing: The copy is no longer on the machine (it expired or was cancelled): start again.
work.error.unsupported: That machine's engine cannot do this yet: update it.
work.error.unwrap_failed: The task could not unwrap the snapshot of the carried work in its worktree.
work.carry.title: Carry “{project}” to {machine}
work.carry.clean: Nothing unpushed: the branch is already on the remote.
work.carry.large_hint: Over 10 MB: they stay behind unless you check them.
work.carry.lfs: Uses Git LFS: its files do not travel; {machine} downloads them from the remote if they are there.
work.carry.submodules: Has submodules: their commits do not travel; {machine} downloads them from the remote if they are there.
work.carry.ssh: They travel through the machine's SSH tunnel; Danil does not see them.
work.carry.size_warn: It is {size}: it will take a while to copy.
work.carry.too_large: It is over 1 GB: too much to copy; push the branch and {machine} clones it.
work.carry.push_copied: Copied: {command}. Run it in your terminal and send again.
work.progress.label: Carry to {machine}
work.failure.missing_base: {machine} lacks the base of your commits (was the branch rewritten on the remote?). The whole branch is sent: {size}.
work.failure.missing_base_unknown: {machine} lacks the base of your commits (was the branch rewritten on the remote?). The whole branch is sent.
work.failure.interrupted: The copy stopped at part {part} of {parts}.
work.failure.export: Could not prepare the copy on {machine}.
work.bring.title: Bring “{task}” from {machine} to {here}
work.bring.branch_hint: If {branch} already exists here with other commits, or is checked out in the folder or a worktree, it arrives as {branch}-{machine}. The folder here is not touched.
work.bring.missing_project: {here} does not have “{project}”: it is cloned first.
work.bring.ignored_hint: None is checked: on {machine} they are usually generated.
work.bring.continue: Continue in a new task here
work.bring.busy: The agent is still in a turn: what you bring is a snapshot of now.
work.carry.creates: created from the copy, without a remote
